name: layntra
description: Controlled Codex-to-Figma workflows for editable product design.

interface.shortDescription: Use your local bridge for editable Figma changes.
interface.longDescription: The local Codex transport for the current Figma file. It avoids hosted Figma MCP quotas, shows a bounded plan, and applies only approved changes to explicit targets.
defaultPrompt: $layntra inspect selection — do not modify Figma
$layntra plan selection — improve hierarchy without changing copy
